name: canvas-apps-codex
description: Create, edit, validate, and sync Power Apps Canvas Apps using Codex and the Canvas Authoring MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Build and edit Power Apps Canvas Apps with Codex
interface.longDescription: A Codex-compatible adaptation of Microsoft’s Canvas Apps Power Platform workflow. It bundles the Canvas Authoring MCP server and skills for configuring, creating, editing, validating, and syncing Canvas Apps from .pa.yaml source files.
defaultPrompt: Configure the Canvas Authoring MCP server for my open Power Apps Studio app.
Create a simple Canvas App from requirements.
Edit the current Canvas App using the live coauthoring session.
